pages.observed: Five samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of option a. Daytime airport curb scene with canopy, skyline, trees, a phone panel reading Ride requested, airplane pickup sign and an empty marked pickup bay. A white SUV with a roof sensor slides in from the left and reaches the bay edge by 0.8 s. Caption box present from 0.2 s.

Samples 1.0 to 1.8 s. Wide curb view unchanged. White SUV with red-lit rear lamp has moved into the marked bay and creeps right, front wheel near the bay's right edge by 1.8 s. Phone still reads Ride requested. Caption band sits just below the car.

Samples 2.0 to 2.8 s. Car parked in bay at 2.0 to 2.4 s, Texas outline locator card appears top right. At 2.6 s cut to cab interior from behind the front seats: windshield shows the airplane sign, steering wheel with no hands, dash map screen, both front seats empty. Phone panel stays at upper left. Caption band overlays the seat backs.

Samples 3.0 to 3.8 s, interior cab view. Wheel rim marker rotates clockwise with no hands and seats empty. The airplane sign outside drifts right and partly exits the windshield frame. Dash screen route dot moves. Locator card at top right completes a Texas outline. Phone unchanged at Ride requested.

Samples 4.0 to 4.8 s. Interior view holds nearly unchanged: wheel turned with marker at right, empty seats, mostly blank pale windshield with sign edge at right, dash route screen. Locator card shows a small marker. Phone still reads Ride requested, not arriving.

Samples 5.0 to 5.8 s. Interior view at 5.0 to 5.2 s with caption gone at 5.2. Cut at 5.4 s to a closer curb composition: large tilted phone in left foreground, white car stopped in the marked bay beside the airplane sign. Phone still reads Ride requested and Finding a car through 5.8 s; no pin slide or arriving label seen in these samples. Caption reads the airport included.

Samples 6.0 to 6.8 s, close curb shot. Phone route marker moves to the destination pin and the card switches from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s. White car stays stopped in the bay beside the airplane sign. Caption the airport included through 6.4 s, then no caption.

Samples 7.0 to 7.8 s. New shot: a pale paper map lies on a wooden table under open sky, a February calendar page stands behind it. Map shows faint grid, two green patches and three tiny pin markers. At 7.8 s a short blue river line and a faint curved line start drawing. Caption The service began in February from 7.2 s.

Samples 8.0 to 8.8 s. Same tabletop map. A blue river line draws from the top edge to the bottom, and thin gray street lines and a faint ring road appear. Pins remain small at center. February page stands behind the map. Locator card fades out. Map occupies roughly the middle third of the frame.

Samples 9.0 to 9.8 s. Wide map until 9.2 s; caption gone at 9.2. Cut at 9.4 s to a closer map. At 9.6 s a 60 square miles, Limited area tag lands near the top with a red pin; a February page slides in from the right and lands on the map's lower right at 9.8 s. A dark outline stroke begins near the upper-left patch; no closed outline yet.

Samples 10.0 to 10.8 s. Close map. A black outline traces from the upper left across the top and down the right side, ending near the right-hand pin at 10.8 s, still open. The 60 square miles tag sits at top; the February page drifts to the lower left of the map. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Samples 11.0 to 11.8 s. The black outline closes into an irregular polygon around the three pins at 11.2 s and fills with a translucent gray. The 60 square miles tag and February page stay in place. Frame then holds the completed outline. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.
Samples 12.0 to 12.8 s. Completed outline map held. A very small white car mark sits by the lower-left pin inside the outline and shifts a few pixels. Caption gone at 12.8 s. No other change.

Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s. Map holds at 13.0 s, then cut at 13.2 s to a wide creek: broad flat brown water, a white car with roof sensor pod partly submerged and reflected, a stepped limestone bank at right, trees behind. Disclosure now reads Illustration. A different car, April 20th account. Car shows no visible motion across these samples. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek from 13.4 s.

Samples 14.0 to 14.8 s. Same wide creek. Small camera drift. Car stays in place in brown water with a thin pale wake line appearing at its right front from 14.6 s. Windows show no occupants at this size. Caption unchanged. The car is small, roughly a fifth of frame width.

Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s. Wide creek at 15.0 to 15.2 s, then at 15.4 s a closer medium framing of the same car in brown water. The car's body tips slightly with a darker mud band on the lower door and a wheel arch showing by 15.8 s; a pale wake streams from its front-right. Car stays near frame center; no clear downstream travel visible within these samples.

Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s. Medium shot: the white car is tilted with its front lifted, a muddy band on the doors, wheels visible, spray and a curling wake at the front. Trees behind slide leftward across samples while the car stays centered, giving a sense of the car being carried rightward. Windows show seat backs, no people. Caption unchanged.

Samples 17.0 to 17.8 s. The tilted creek car slides toward the left edge and is partly out of frame at 17.4 s. Cut at 17.6 s to a street flood: tan house, tree, green street sign, fence, brown water across the road with a white car standing in it, wide pale sidewalk in the lower half. Disclosure now Illustration. Another car, earlier in April. No caption in these two samples.

Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s. Street-flood wide shot. The white car moves slightly right and the brown water rises to cover its wheels up to the arches by 18.6 to 18.8 s. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater sits just below the car. Sidewalk occupies the lower half of the frame.

Samples 19.0 to 19.8 s. Same wide street-flood framing; car is stopped with water to the wheel arches. Small amber lamp glows appear at the front and rear corners at 19.6 to 19.8 s. Car occupies a small part of frame (about a third of width); caption sits just under it.

Samples 20.0 to 20.8 s. Closer shot of the stopped white car in brown water up to its wheel arches; windows show empty seats. Amber corner lamps alternate on and off across samples. Background house and sign are softened. Car is held still; caption beneath.

Samples 21.0 to 21.8 s. Same medium street-flood shot. Hazard lamps blink on and off across samples; red tail lamp visible at left. Car and water hold still; empty seats through windows. Caption unchanged.

Samples 22.0 to 22.8 s. Street flood held at 22.0 s, then cut to an olive wall above a brown desk. A cream card headed Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall slides leftward onto the desk with a pen at its right edge; by 22.8 s a field begins writing in (Reca / Sof partially typed). Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.4 s.

Samples 23.0 to 23.8 s. Record card slides to center of desk. Field rows write in: Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791 typed with a text cursor, complete by 23.6 to 23.8 s. Pen tip rests at the card's right. Card occupies about two thirds of frame width.

Samples 24.0 to 24.8 s. Completed record card held, then at 24.6 s a new framing shows the card above a faint empty grid of car slots on the desk, with a wooden stamp handle edge at right. By 24.8 s three small white car icons fill the first row from the left. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Samples 25.0 to 25.8 s. The car-icon grid fills row by row from left to right, almost full at 25.8 s. A hand and forearm in a blue sleeve bring a wooden stamp from the right edge over the record card's top right. Card fields unchanged. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Samples 26.0 to 26.8 s. Grid of car icons complete. A hand holding a wooden stamp presses onto the card's upper-right header; at 26.8 s an amber stamp outline with partial text Sof becomes visible as the stamp lifts. A tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record drops in at 26.4 s and settles between card and grid.

Samples 27.0 to 27.8 s. A crooked amber stamp reading Software recall now sits on the card header; the hand and stamp withdraw to the right and leave frame by 27.6 s. The tag Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record, and the full icon grid hold. Caption unchanged.

Samples 28.0 to 28.8 s. Desk composition held, then at 28.4 s cut to a side view of a dark two-lane road with grass verge, lamp post, trees and distant skyline. A white car with roof pod enters from the left and moves right. Disclosure Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event. At 28.8 s a faint card with the recall sentence fades in above. No standing water visible yet in this framing.

Samples 29.0 to 29.8 s. Recall sentence card is now fully legible at top. The white car drives right with the camera tracking it; the lamp post exits left and road dashes and trees slide by. No standing water visible yet. Car sits just above the caption band.

Samples 30.0 to 30.8 s. Tracking side view continues. At 30.6 s the car's rear brake lamp glows red. At 30.8 s the edge of a pale bluish ellipse enters at the right of the lane ahead of the car, the first sign of standing water. Recall sentence card stays at top.

Samples 31.0 to 31.8 s. The car, brake lamp lit early in this span, closes on a pale water patch that sits at the right edge of the lane; background motion has nearly stopped, consistent with slowing. Water patch is partly hidden behind the right frame edge and at the caption's top edge. Car remains just above the caption band.

Samples 32.0 to 32.6 s: car slowly approaches the pale water patch at the right edge; no contact yet. At 32.8 s a closer framing: large side view of the white car, rims and empty windows visible, with only a thin wavy pale line under the tires and dark road around it. Recall card enlarged at top. No caption at 32.6 to 32.8 s.

Samples 33.0 to 33.8 s. Close side view: the white car sits mid-frame with headlamp lit; a pale gray water shape advances from the right edge toward the front wheel and reaches just ahead of it by 33.8 s. Recall card overlaps the background trees at top. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. The word may in the card is not visibly highlighted.

Samples 34.0 to 34.8 s. Close side view: the front wheel is now on the pale water sheet; small splash lines appear at the front tire at 34.8 s. In the recall card an amber highlight box appears from 34.2 s, but it covers the characters y allo (straddling may and allow) instead of the word may. Car stays roughly centered, little visible forward travel.

Samples 35.0 to 35.8 s. Close side view: the car is fully on the pale water sheet with wake lines and splashes at both wheels and reflections below. The car stays near center while the background drifts slightly. The amber highlight box in the card still covers y allo. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Samples 36.0 to 36.8 s. Car continues through the pale water sheet with wake lines; background tree and lamp shift left, car held centered. Caption disappears at 36.6 s. Card highlight still covers y allo. No stop, crash or other outcome drawn.

Samples 37.0 to 37.8 s. Cut back to the recall card on the desk, now taller. A new Remedy row wipes in from the left and reads The remedy is currently under development by 37.6 s, with its background lit pale amber. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development from 37.2 s.

Samples 38.0 to 38.8 s. Card held with Remedy row lit. A hand in a blue sleeve holding a pen enters from the right edge and rests the pen tip on the remedy row beside the text The remedy is currently under development at 38.6 to 38.8 s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 39.0 to 39.8 s. Slightly closer framing at 39.2 s. While the pen hand keeps its tip on the remedy row, a second blue-sleeved arm brings a wooden stamp from the lower right and slides it leftward over the bottom of the remedy row; it has not pressed down yet. Both arms come from the right edge, roughly parallel.

Samples 40.0 to 40.8 s. The stamp hand presses the wooden stamp onto the lower left of the remedy row, then lifts and draws back to the right, leaving an amber, slightly crooked Under development impression by 40.6 s. The pen hand stays on the row. Caption unchanged.

Samples 41.0 to 41.8 s. Both hands withdraw from the stamped card. Cut at 41.6 s to a parking lot: four white roof-pod cars parked in angled bays, a wire between two posts above them, an April calendar page at left, a Vehicle maps card with a blue route at right, trees and skyline behind. At 41.8 s a tag with text ending ther limits slides in from the left edge onto the wire. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits.

Samples 42.0 to 42.8 s. A tag reading Weather limits, tightened with a cloud and rain icon slides along the wire and settles at a red pin above the four parked cars by 42.8 s. April page and Vehicle maps card stay at left and right. The four cars do not move. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits.

Samples 43.0 to 43.8 s. Same parking-lot composition. The Weather limits tag shifts slightly right on the wire and tilts a little at 43.8 s. Four cars, April page and Vehicle maps card hold still. Caption unchanged.

Samples 44.0 to 44.8 s. The same lot composition holds: the Weather limits tag sways slightly on its wire, while the four cars, April page and Vehicle maps card stay still. No new object or state appears in this second. Caption unchanged.

Samples 45.0 to 45.8 s. Same lot composition; caption gap at 45.4 s. From 45.6 s a slight push-in makes the four cars, tag, April page and maps card a little larger. No check marks on cars yet. New caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth at 45.8 s.

Samples 46.0 to 46.8 s. Circular check-mark badges pop in above the four parked cars from left to right; three are complete by 46.6 s and the fourth is drawing at 46.8 s. The April page still shows only the month header with blank lines, no 20. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

Samples 47.0 to 47.8 s. All four cars carry check badges. A small check draws on the Vehicle maps card at 47.2 to 47.4 s with a tiny subline (reads like updated, very small). April page still shows only the month header with no day number. Caption unchanged.

Samples 48.0 to 48.8 s. Lot composition with all four cars checked holds; at 48.8 s the calendar page flips and shows a large 20 with the April header mid-flip. The 20 appears after the four car checks (checks completed by 47.0 s). Caption unchanged.

Samples 49.0 to 49.8 s. Calendar now reads April 20 with the flipped page above it settling by 49.6 s. Four checked cars, Weather limits tag and Vehicle maps updated card hold. Caption ends at 49.8 s.

Samples 50.0 to 50.8 s. Return to the opening's wide airport curb: canopy, bench, suitcase, airplane sign, skyline, white car parked in the bay, phone panel at upper left now reading Arriving. Disclosure Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. Car shows no visible change; doors closed through 50.8 s. Caption So the airport ride is open from 50.2 s.

Samples 51.0 to 51.8 s. Same wide curb shot. The car's rear side door swings open starting at 51.2 s and stays open, showing a dark gap with a beige interior panel. The door is small at this framing. Phone still reads Arriving. Caption So the airport ride is open.

Samples 52.0 to 52.8 s. Wide curb with the rear door open holds; caption gone at 52.6 s. At 52.8 s a new framing: the car sits smaller in its bay with the open door, a bench holds a small phone, and a recall record card with The remedy is currently under development and an amber stamp sits tilted on the asphalt below the car. The big phone panel is no longer shown. Card text is small at this size.

Samples 53.0 to 53.8 s. Car with open rear door at the bay; a small recall card lies on the asphalt in the lane in front of the car and slides slightly left and settles by 53.8 s. Card text The remedy is currently under development is very small at this size; amber stamp text not legible. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy sits right under the card.

Samples 54.0 to 54.8 s. The recall card slides toward the viewer and enlarges in the lower middle; by 54.6 s it covers the lower part of the car including its wheels. Text Federal recall record, Remedy, The remedy is currently under development and an amber Under development stamp are legible. Open-door car remains visible above the card. Caption sits right under the card.

Samples 55.0 to 55.8 s. Composition holds: the remedy card sits in front of the open-door car, overlapping its lower body and wheels; slight drift only. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy just below the card.

Samples 56.0 to 56.8 s. After the card-over-curb hold, a cut at 56.4 s to a split frame: top half is the curb with the white car and its rear door open beside the airplane sign; bottom half is a brown desk holding the remedy card (Under development stamp) and a small phone with a route and Arriving. Caption as currently under development from 56.6 s.

Samples 57.0 to 57.8 s. Split frame holds: open-door car at the curb above, recall card and small phone on the desk below. A thin dark underline draws under the remedy text, extending to full width by 57.8 s. Caption as currently under development.

Samples 58.0 to 58.8 s. The split frame with open-door car and underlined remedy card holds until about 58.4 s, captions end at 58.2. Cut at 58.6 s to a dark credits card with a Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and source, illustration, map and music credits.

Samples 59.0 to 59.8 s. Static dark credits card: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, Sources (Waymo October 14th, NHTSA recall 26E026, Texas Public Radio May 10th and 13th), Illustration, Map and Music credit lines. No motion between samples.

Samples 60.0 to 60.8 s. The same static credits card as the previous second: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the sources, illustration, map and music lines. No change across samples.
Samples 61.0 to 61.8 s. Unchanged static credits card: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the credit blocks. No motion.
Samples 62.0 to 62.8 s. Same static credits card, unchanged in all five samples: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and credit blocks.
Samples 63.0, 63.2, 63.4 and the final frame 63.433 s (frame 1903). The static credits card holds unchanged to the end of option a.

Samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of option b. Overhead view of a road with a pickup bay outline beside a sidewalk with a bench, a phone and a teal suitcase. A white car seen from above, roof sensor visible, drives up the lane toward the bay. At 0.2 to 0.6 s the caption band sits on top of the car; by 0.8 s the car has passed above it. Phone panel at upper left reads Ride requested. No airport sign or canopy visible in this overhead view.

Samples 1.0 to 1.8 s. Overhead: the white car moves up into the pickup bay outline and stops within it by 1.4 s, red tail lamps lit. Phone panel still Ride requested. Caption sits below the car. Car occupies a small portion of the frame width.

Samples 2.0 to 2.8 s. Overhead car parked in the bay while a Texas locator card fades in top right. At 2.6 s cut to the cab interior from behind empty front seats: steering wheel, dash route screen, windshield showing an airplane pickup sign. Phone panel overlays upper left. Caption overlays the seat backs.

Samples 3.0 to 3.8 s. Cab interior: the steering wheel turns by itself (rim marker rotating clockwise), seats empty, the airplane sign moves right and leaves the windshield, the dash route dot advances, and the locator card completes a Texas outline. Phone stays Ride requested. This interior matches option a's 3.0 to 3.8 s view.

Samples 4.0 to 4.8 s. Interior view holds with the wheel turned and seats empty; mostly blank windshield with a sign edge at right; locator card shows a small marker. Phone still Ride requested. No new action visible.

Samples 5.0 to 5.8 s. Interior hold, caption gone at 5.2 s. Cut at 5.4 s to a ground-level curb shot with a large tilted phone in front of the car parked at the airplane sign; phone still reads Ride requested, Finding a car. The locator card draws a ring. Caption the airport included. This composition matches option a's 5.4 to 5.8 s.

Samples 6.0 to 6.8 s. Phone route marker reaches the destination pin and the card changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s; the white car remains in the bay at the airplane sign. Caption ends after 6.4 s. Same as option a in this interval.

Samples 7.0 to 7.8 s. Overhead flat map nearly filling the frame width on an olive ground, with a February calendar page already resting at its lower left. Faint grid, two green patches, three tiny pins. At 7.8 s a blue river segment and thin gray lines start to draw. Caption The service began in February from 7.2 s.

Samples 8.0 to 8.8 s. On the overhead map a blue river line draws from top to bottom, a second blue line appears at right, and gray radial roads and a ring road draw in around the pins. The locator card fades out. February page remains at lower left. Caption The service began in February.

Samples 9.0 to 9.8 s. Overhead map holds, then at 9.4 s a cut to the same map lying on a wooden plank table in perspective with sky above. At 9.6 s a 60 square miles, Limited area tag with a red pin drops near the top and a February page slides in from the right to rest at lower right by 9.8 s. A black outline stroke begins at the upper-left patch. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Samples 10.0 to 10.8 s. Map on the wooden table; a black outline traces clockwise from upper left across the top and down the right side, still open at 10.8 s. The February page moves to the lower left. Same action as option a in this interval, in a table framing.

Samples 11.0 to 11.8 s. The black outline closes into a polygon around the three pins and fills translucent gray by 11.4 s, then holds. Tag 60 square miles, Limited area and the February page remain. Caption unchanged.
Samples 12.0 to 12.8 s. Completed outline held on the table map; a very small white car mark moves a few pixels by the lower-left pin. Caption ends at 12.8 s. No other change.

Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s. Map holds at 13.0 s, then a cut at 13.2 s to an overhead creek: a brown water band runs across the frame between pale wavy banks and round green tree canopies. A white car seen from above sits in the water with faint wake lines; it moves only slightly. Disclosure Illustration. A different car, April 20th account. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek from 13.4 s, overlapping the lower bank.

Samples 14.0 to 14.8 s. Overhead creek. The white car sits mid-channel with wake lines; a curved pale bow-wave appears against its right end at 14.6 s. The car does not visibly travel along the creek in this second. Cabin interior not visible from above. Caption overlaps the lower bank.

Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s. Overhead creek held to 15.2 s, then a cut to a side view at water level: the white car sits deep in wide brown water with its reflection, a pale wake curling off its right end, rain streaks, a flat-topped tree on the far bank. Car stays near frame center and tilts slightly by 15.8 s. Car occupies about half the frame width.

Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s. Side view in the brown water: the car, mud band on its doors and empty seat backs in its windows, stays centered while the far-bank trees slide left, indicating drift to the right with the current. Wake curls from its right end; rain streaks continue. Caption unchanged.

Samples 17.0 to 17.8 s. The creek car slides toward the left edge and is partly off-frame at 17.4 s (moving opposite to the earlier rightward background drift). Cut at 17.6 s to an overhead street: four hip-roofed houses drawn as gray and black triangle facets, two round trees, a brown water band across the street with a white car seen from above, and a dark gray patch at the right end. Disclosure Illustration. Another car, earlier in April.

Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s. Overhead flooded street: the remaining dark road patch at right disappears as brown water fills the whole band by 18.4 s. The white car drifts slightly right. The caption overlaps the lower row of house roofs. Car is small in frame.

Samples 19.0 to 19.8 s. Overhead flooded street held; the white car moves slightly right then stops. Small pale marks at the car's corners are faint; an amber hazard blink is not clearly readable at this scale in these samples. Caption overlaps the lower house roofs.

Samples 20.0 to 20.8 s. Cut to a street-level side view: the white car sits in brown floodwater up to its lower doors in front of a row of tan houses, a tree, fence and green street signs; empty seat backs visible in windows. Amber corner lamps glow at 20.2 to 20.4 s and are off at 20.6 s. Car does not move. Wide pale sidewalk occupies the lower half.

Samples 21.0 to 21.8 s. Street-level shot holds: the stopped car's amber hazard lamps blink on and off; slight camera reframing. Empty seats visible through windows. Caption sits on the sidewalk below the water line.

Samples 22.0 to 22.8 s. Street flood at 22.0 s, then cut to an overhead brown desk on an olive ground. A tilted cream Federal recall record card slides in from the right with a pen near its lower right; at 22.8 s field text starts typing (Reca, Sof). Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.4 s.

Samples 23.0 to 23.8 s. Overhead desk: the record card straightens and its rows type in, Recall type Software and Potential units affected 3,791, complete by 23.8 s. Pen rests at lower right. Same action as option a's card, framed from above.

Samples 24.0 to 24.8 s. Completed card held, then at 24.6 s a reframe: card at top, faint grid of empty car slots below, wooden stamp handle edge at right. At 24.8 s three white car icons fill the first row. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Same as option a.
Samples 25.0 to 25.8 s. Car-icon grid fills row by row, nearly full at 25.8 s; a blue-sleeved hand carries a wooden stamp in from the right over the card. Same as option a in this interval.

Samples 26.0 to 26.8 s. Same action as option a: the stamp presses on the card, a Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record tag drops in and settles, and an amber Software stamp mark appears as the stamp lifts at 26.8 s.
Samples 27.0 to 27.8 s. Same as option a: crooked amber Software recall stamp on the card, hand and stamp leave to the right, tag and full icon grid hold.

Samples 28.0 to 28.8 s. Desk held, then cut at 28.4 s to an overhead straight road with grass verges. A white car seen from above drives up the lane; at 28.6 s the caption covers part of the car. At 28.8 s a semi-transparent recall sentence card fades in near the top. Disclosure Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event.

Samples 29.0 to 29.8 s. Overhead road: the recall sentence card is fully legible near the top. The car holds near lower center as the lane dashes scroll, implying forward travel. From 29.2 s a gray water shape enters at the top of the road ahead and grows, partly hidden behind the disclosure and the recall card. Caption sits just below the car.

Samples 30.0 to 30.8 s. Overhead road: the standing-water patch occupies the upper right part of the road and comes closer as the road scrolls, its lower part emerging below the recall card by 30.8 s. The car's red brake lamps show at 30.8 s. Caption sits just under the car.

Samples 31.0 to 31.8 s. Overhead road: the car with lit red brake lamps approaches a large pale water patch ahead; road dashes barely shift, consistent with slowing. The water's lower edge is a short distance in front of the car at 31.8 s. The upper part of the patch is hidden behind the recall card.

Samples 32.0 to 32.6 s: overhead, the car with brake lamps sits just short of the pale water patch. At 32.8 s a cut to a close side view: the white car on the road with its headlamp lit and a thin wavy line beneath its tires, the recall sentence card large at top. Matches option a's close shot from 32.8 s.

Samples 33.0 to 33.8 s. Same close side view as option a: a pale water shape advances from the right edge toward the front wheel, reaching just ahead of it by 33.8 s. The word may in the recall card is not highlighted in these samples. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Samples 34.0 to 34.8 s. Same as option a: the water sheet reaches under the front wheel with a small splash at 34.8 s; an amber highlight box appears in the recall card at 34.2 s but sits over the characters y allo instead of the word may.

Samples 35.0 to 35.8 s. Same as option a: the car sits fully on the pale water sheet with wake lines and splashes at both wheels; the background drifts slightly; the amber highlight still covers y allo.
Samples 36.0 to 36.8 s. Same as option a: car continues through the water with wakes, background slides left, caption ends at 36.6 s, highlight still over y allo. No crash or stop drawn.

Samples 37.0 to 37.8 s. Same as option a: cut to the tall recall card; a Remedy row wipes in reading The remedy is currently under development and lights pale amber. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development from 37.2 s.
Samples 38.0 to 38.8 s. Same as option a: a hand holding a pen enters from the right and rests its tip on the remedy row beside under development.

Samples 39.0 to 39.8 s. Same as option a: closer framing, pen hand resting on the remedy row, a second blue-sleeved arm slides a wooden stamp leftward across the lower remedy row without pressing yet.

Samples 40.0 to 40.8 s. Same as option a: the stamp presses onto the lower remedy row and lifts away to the right, leaving a slightly crooked amber Under development impression. Pen hand stays on the row.

Samples 41.0 to 41.8 s. Hands withdraw from the stamped card. Cut at 41.6 s to an overhead lot: four white cars seen from above in marked bays, an April page pinned at upper left, a tree at upper right. At 41.8 s a tag slides in from the left edge near the top. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits.

Samples 42.0 to 42.8 s. Overhead lot: a Weather limits, tightened tag slides in from the left, partly occluded by the April page until about 42.6 s, and settles at the upper left with a cloud and rain icon at 42.8 s. The four cars do not move. The tag is small and near the top edge, not pinned above the cars.
Samples 43.0 to 43.8 s. Overhead lot holds: the Weather limits tag sits at the top beside the April page, sliding slightly right and tilting at 43.8 s. Four parked cars unchanged.
